dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hiding Hobbyist
dialogues.text: Gaaah! My friend, you scared the living daylight out of me!

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hiding Hobbyist
dialogues.text: I'm looking for the perfect treasure spot!

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hiding Hobbyist
dialogues.text: Hiding stuff back in Constellation Metropole always just seemed way too simple.

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hiding Hobbyist
dialogues.text: It's fun to give the treasure-seeker a bit of a challenge once in a while, no?
